# 般若心經註疏

**Byline:** 清 仲之屏纂註

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Kāngxī-era (1675) Heart Sūtra commentary by [仲之屏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%B2%E4%B9%8B%E5%B1%8F) Zhòng Zhīpíng (courtesy names *Shìshí* 士石 and *Shùruò* 樹若), the Jiāxīng *jūshì* lay devotee. Preserved in the Wàn xùzàng / *Manji zoku-zō* as X564. Signature: 「清　嘉興　仲之屏樹若甫纂註／秀水　沈　浤㵎思甫校梓」 — "compiled-and-annotated by Zhòng Zhīpíng *Shùruòfǔ* of Jiāxīng of the Qīng; collated and printed by Shěn Hóng *Sīfǔ* of Xiùshuǐ".

The genre marker — *zhùshū* "annotated subcommentary" — signals an integrated *zhù* (annotation) plus *shū* (subcommentary) format, typical of the late-imperial *jūshì* commentarial style.

**Abstract**

X564 is one of the more philosophically pointed *jūshì* Heart Sūtra commentaries of the early Kāngxī period. The framing thesis — that the Heart Sūtra is the *source-confluence* (統會之源) of all Buddhist sūtras and that the present commentary is in turn the ultimate aim of the Heart Sūtra — is a strong claim about the Heart Sūtra's place in the canonical hierarchy.

The author Zhòng Zhīpíng comes from the same Jiāxīng *jūshì* circle as [王起隆](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E8%B5%B7%E9%9A%86) Wáng Qǐlóng ([KR6c0180](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0180)), and his pairing of *Diamond Sūtra* and Heart Sūtra commentaries (X489 + X564) parallels Wáng's pairing (X484 + X561). The two together document the early-Kāngxī Yangtze-delta *jūshì* programme of producing paired *Diamond Sūtra* and Heart Sūtra commentaries as the foundational *Prajñāpāramitā* devotional infrastructure for lay study.

The collator-and-printer [沈浤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%88%E6%B5%A4) Shěn Hóng (courtesy name *Sīfǔ* 思甫) of Xiùshuǐ documents the network of *jūshì* book-production in the Jiāxīng region — Xiùshuǐ being the centre of the famous Jiāxīng Lèngyán-canon project, the late-Míng / early-Qīng *Jiāxīng zàng* 嘉興藏 / *Lèngyánsì zàng* 楞嚴寺藏 that was one of the major canonical printing projects of the period.

Composition date: 1675 (Kāngxī 14), per the dated preface. Both *notBefore* and *notAfter* are 1675.
